stem: Which sentence best describes Coyote’s relationship with Conejo by the end of the story?

options.label: F
options.text: Coyote is eager to find Conejo so they can become better friends.

options.label: G
options.text: Coyote is grateful to Conejo for showing where to find cheese.

options.label: H
options.text: Coyote is angry with Conejo because he has a comfortable place to live.

options.label: J
options.text: Coyote is upset with Conejo for saying something that was untrue.
